hypothesis: Stronger contrastive explicit-negative supervision with masked unknown cells improves Product-18 short-Event classification.

datasetDesign.rationale: V1 established positive, pair, zero-positive, and masking feasibility. V2 keeps those structures while concentrating 180 strong contrastive negative trials in the smallest pool expected to exceed 72 HIGH_NEGATIVE cells with normal disagreement margin.

cellConsensus.UNCERTAIN: All remaining cases, including every direct POSITIVE versus NEGATIVE conflict

inclusionPolicyDecision: Choose HIGH_ONLY only if it independently meets all per-label polarity, pair-retention, and zero-positive gates; otherwise choose HIGH_PLUS_MEDIUM_EQUAL_WEIGHT if the combined pool passes every frozen gate. Use training-pool agreement statistics only.

trainingIfGatePasses.loss: BCE over boolean-indexed supervised cells only; masked null cells never enter the loss expression

evaluationBoundary: Do not open RTN or COSO per-row evidence until data, consensus, mask, training protocol, and trained checkpoint are frozen.
